user.title: Connect to RTI AD-4x
user.description: The amplifier accepts only one connection at a time, so Home Assistant reads its state at startup and then keeps it current from command replies rather than polling.

reconfigure.title: Update RTI AD-4x connection
reconfigure.description: Update the host or port if the amplifier's network address has changed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the host and port, and make sure nothing else is connected to the amplifier -- it accepts only one client at a time.
error.no_sources: Enter at least one source name.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Successfully updated the amplifier's connection details.

error.no_sources: Enter at least one source name.

all_zones_off.name: All zones off
all_zones_off.description: Turns off every zone on the amplifier that the targeted zone belongs to, using a single command.
